Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one usable character WALK ANIMATION SPRITE SHEET for the 2D indie game Midlife Survivors. Reference image is a STYLE REFERENCE: match the chunky pixel technique, dark navy outlines, warm office palette and the leftmost hero's adult proportions. Do not include the desk or paper enemy.
CANVAS: exactly 1536x1536 pixels, solid flat #FF00FF magenta background. EXACTLY 16 complete character sprites arranged on a strict 4 COLUMN by 4 ROW equal grid, each cell 384x384 pixels. Equal empty magenta padding in EVERY CELL. No grid lines, no separators, no labels, no text. One complete sprite per cell, nothing may cross a cell boundary. All heads at the same scale, feet near local cell y=328, horizontal center x=192. Each character around 225 pixels tall, at least 48px empty padding on all sides.
ROW DIRECTIONS, top to bottom:
ROW 1 = DOWN: facing viewer, see face and chest, walk down.
ROW 2 = UP: facing AWAY from viewer, show back of head and BACK of clothing. Absolutely NO face, eyes or chest in this row. Walk up.
ROW 3 = LEFT: true left-facing profile, nose and toes point LEFT.
ROW 4 = RIGHT: true right-facing profile, nose and toes point RIGHT.
FOUR COLUMNS form a looping walk cycle in EACH ROW:
1 left-foot contact, 2 passing pose with knees close, 3 right-foot contact, 4 opposite passing pose. Alternating feet, opposite arm swing and a tiny one-logical-pixel rise on passing poses. Feet must visibly change position from frame to frame. Strong clear playful stride, lively but believable adult movement. Keep face, body size, costume, props, and handedness consistent in every frame. This is not sixteen copies of one pose.
PIXEL STYLE: designed for a final 56x60 game frame. Simplify aggressively into clear chunky pixel clusters around 5-6 source pixels square. Crisp square edges, one logical pixel navy outline, 2-3 flat tones per material. No tiny hatching, no smooth gradients, no blur or anti-aliasing. Large expressive head, compact readable body. Warm upper-left light, cool navy lower-right shading. NO shadow on the magenta background. NO ground or cast shadow.
Palette: #171C35 outline, #303750 shadow, #526078 slate, #3E7775 teal, #83A89A sage, #A88B70 brown, #D3B78D khaki, #F2D7A1 cream, #FFF0CF warm white, #874C3B russet, #C45C4B muted red, #EF9347 orange, #E5A995 skin, #BFA8CF lavender. Additional darker warm skin tone permitted for the grad student.
No logos, words, watermarks, extra props, action effects, scenery or other characters.
CHARACTER: THE 9-TO-5ER. Preserve the reference leftmost hero's identity: middle-aged man around 40, rectangular black-framed glasses, short messy brown hair grey at temples, tired determined face, white SHORT-SLEEVE dress shirt, loosened red tie, khaki slacks, brown loafers, orange coffee mug in HIS RIGHT HAND throughout. In front view mug appears on viewer LEFT; in back view mug on viewer RIGHT. The tie sways a little with steps; do not change shirt color or mug into other objects. Small steam curl, no giant effects.

CHARACTER: THE SOCCER DAD, age43. A friendly stocky middle-aged father with warm tan skin, short salt-and-pepper beard, short brown-grey hair under a plain navy baseball cap, teal short-sleeve polo, khaki shorts ending at knees, cream socks and comfortable brown/navy sneakers. A small plain coach whistle at neck, no lettering. Holds a compact ORANGE travel mug in HIS RIGHT HAND and a small cream-and-navy soccer ball tucked securely under HIS LEFT ARM, consistent across directions. Cap and cheerful determined eyebrows make a strong silhouette. Lively sideline stride, clothing and held props stay consistent. This is a new generic fictional person, not a portrait of the reference hero.

CHARACTER: THE GRAD STUDENT AT 45. A fictional middle-aged woman around45 with warm medium-brown skin, curly dark brown hair with grey streaks pulled into a messy high bun, big round dark glasses, lavender hoodie, navy trousers and brown comfortable sneakers. Must look clearly adult, not a teenager. Small warm khaki backpack worn on BOTH shoulders, visible from rear and sides; one cream notebook hugged against torso in LEFT ARM; compact orange lidded coffee cup in RIGHT HAND. A resourceful tired-but-determined expression. Bun and backpack make an unmistakable silhouette. The notebook stays tucked, free elbow has small swing and backpack shifts gently with the walk. No graduation cap, no text.
